races.name: Cumberland Show Saturday 6th June Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race)

runners_data.name: Tap Tap Shamie
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with decent recent form for the in-form Olly Murphy stable, well-suited to the soft ground conditions.

runners_data.name: Dream On Mick
runners_data.note: Lightly raced winner last time out but long absence since pulled-up run creates uncertainty about current form.

runners_data.name: Jet Noir
runners_data.note: Will get an uncontested lead but has shown a tendency to fade in the finish in recent outings.

runners_data.name: Patrick's Wells
runners_data.note: Returns after a massive 882-day break which makes him hard to assess despite his hold-up style suiting the likely pace.

runners_data.name: The Shanachie
runners_data.note: Lightly raced sort who stays on in his races but lacks the class to trouble these rivals.

runners_data.name: The Grey Venture
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse whose recent form shows a pattern of fading in the finish, limiting his appeal.

runners_data.name: Maccarellu
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with excellent soft ground record and the experience edge, returning from a break for Venetia Williams.

runners_data.name: Aristelle
runners_data.note: Hold-up mare with 10lb claimer Leah Noreci taking off valuable weight, has shown ability in similar conditions.

runners_data.name: McElhattan
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse in good recent form for Donald McCain, with 3lb claimer William Maggs reducing his burden.

runners_data.name: Last Man Standing
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with solid soft ground form but recent efforts suggest he may be on the decline.

races.paceDynamic: Jet Noir is the sole confirmed front runner and will get an easy lead in this modest maiden hurdle field. With no other early pace, he'll dictate a comfortable tempo through the early stages with Tap Tap Shamie, Maccarellu and the prominent runners sitting just behind. The lack of pace pressure means the race will develop into a sprint from the back of the last flight, with the field bunching up for a late kick. This setup strongly favours hold-up horses — the sustainable pace will keep the field together and allow closers to unleash their finishing speed when it matters most.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Jet Noir sets a steady pace as expected and the field stays bunched
scenarios.body: The lack of early pace allows patient riders on Aristelle, McElhattan and Last Man Standing to time their challenges perfectly. These horses get the strong gallop they need from the last flight to show their best.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Steals It
scenarios.trigger: If Jet Noir gets away with a soft lead and kicks clear approaching the last
scenarios.body: Despite his tendency to fade, the easy conditions and lack of pace pressure allows him to maintain his advantage to the line. The hold-up horses are caught flat-footed by the sudden injection of pace.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Trackers Strike
scenarios.trigger: If Tap Tap Shamie or Maccarellu track the leader closely and pounce after the last
scenarios.body: The experienced Maccarellu has solid soft ground form and can outbattle Jet Noir, while Tap Tap Shamie brings the best recent form to the table. Their position saves vital ground when the race develops.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Completely
scenarios.trigger: If Jet Noir goes very slowly and no one wants to make the running
scenarios.body: The race becomes a tactical crawl where stamina counts for nothing and only pure speed from the last flight matters. This chaos scenario can produce surprise results from horses who wouldn't normally win.

watchPoints.text: Jet Noir could steal this if allowed to dictate his own fractions - monitor if anyone tracks him closely early
Dream On Mick's fitness after 84 days off following a pulled-up effort - market support would be telling
Maccarellu returning from 118-day break for Venetia Williams - stable's runners often need their first run back
Patrick's Wells makes his first appearance in 882 days - impossible to assess his current ability level
The amateur and apprentice jockeys on several runners could make tactical errors in what may become a messy finish

races.name: Feel Good Friday 29th May Novices' Handicap Chase (GBB Race)

runners_data.name: Big Zouk
runners_data.note: Prominent racer returning from 50-day break for in-form Nicky Richards but faces a tactical disadvantage if pace stays modest

runners_data.name: Benmore
runners_data.note: Only confirmed front runner with recent win on similar going but faces tactical pressure as lone pace setter against multiple hold-up horses

runners_data.name: You Some Girl
runners_data.note: Versatile hold-up performer who excels on good ground with excellent course record of 4 wins from 15 runs at similar venues

runners_data.name: Orkney Blue
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with inconsistent recent form but trainer N W Alexander running 0 from 11 in past 14 days suggests low expectations

runners_data.name: Eaton Anne
runners_data.note: Hold-up mare for in-form Olly Murphy stable (7 from 22 recent winners) with Sean Bowen booking adding confidence despite moderate recent form

runners_data.name: Loulou Madrik
runners_data.note: Youngest horse at 5 years old running in prominent style but faces stronger opposition than recent hurdle runs would suggest

races.paceDynamic: Benmore is the sole confirmed front runner and will set the pace without early pressure from this small field. Big Zouk and Loulou Madrik as prominent racers may track the leader but are unlikely to engage early over this staying trip. The pace will be sustainable rather than searching, with the four hold-up horses (I Wish You, You Some Girl, Orkney Blue, Eaton Anne) settling well back in the early stages. This setup strongly favours hold-up horses — the modest pace will keep the field together and create a sprint finish where the closers can unleash their finishing kicks.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-up horses dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the pace remains steady throughout with Benmore allowed an easy lead
scenarios.body: The field stays bunched allowing the four hold-up specialists to time their challenges perfectly in the closing stages. Class horses like I Wish You and You Some Girl can exploit their superior finishing speed when not compromised by a searching gallop.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front end surprise
scenarios.trigger: If Benmore maintains his recent winning form and the pace doesn't suit the hold-up brigade
scenarios.body: The leader gets first run on the field and his stamina proves superior to the closers who find the race run to suit the pace angle. Big Zouk could emerge as the main danger tracking the winner throughout.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent tracker prevails
scenarios.trigger: If Big Zouk or Loulou Madrik improve significantly from their tracking positions
scenarios.body: One of the prominent racers gets the perfect trip stalking Benmore before striking in the straight with enough left to hold off the late closers. The winner avoids both pace pressure and traffic problems that could hinder the hold-up horses.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace collapse scenario
scenarios.trigger: If Benmore sets a genuinely strong pace or gets pressured early by the prominent racers
scenarios.body: The early pace becomes searching enough to compromise the leader and prominent trackers, but also spreads the field too much for effective late challenges. An unconsidered finisher benefits from the pace collapse but this seems unlikely given the field composition.

watchPoints.text: Benmore must be monitored early for any signs of the pace becoming stronger than expected which would transform the race dynamics
I Wish You carrying 168lbs needs to be travelling comfortably in the back half to suggest the weight burden isn't compromising his chance
Big Zouk returning after 50 days for Nicky Richards whose recent 2 from 16 record suggests this runner may need the outing
You Some Girl hasn't run for 99 days and needs to show early sharpness to suggest the lengthy break hasn't dulled her competitive edge
Track Sean Bowen's riding tactics on Eaton Anne as the champion jockey's positioning often signals stable expectations

races.paceDynamic: Kyntara, Rocheval and Ballin Bay will ensure a genuine gallop from the start, with all three confirmed front-runners likely to dispute the early lead. This strong pace will test stamina over the extended 3m1f trip on testing good to soft ground. The sustained gallop will stretch the field and create opportunities for the patient hold-up horses to sweep through tired leaders in the final half-mile. This setup strongly favours hold-up horses — the pace is genuine and the field will be strung out, allowing closers to exploit tired front-runners.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the three front-runners maintain a strong gallop throughout the first two miles
scenarios.body: The pace will collapse in the final half-mile as Kyntara, Rocheval and Ballin Bay tire, creating perfect conditions for the hold-up brigade. Jupiter Des Mottes, Dr Seb and Cooler Than Me are ideally positioned to exploit this scenario with their patient tactics.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front-Runner Survives Solo
scenarios.trigger: If one of the pace-setters can break clear and find a soft lead after the early skirmishing
scenarios.body: Ballin Bay's recent winning form suggests he could dictate terms if allowed to dominate alone, with his stamina proving superior to his pace rivals. The hold-up horses may leave their challenges too late if the pace becomes too comfortable.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Runners Benefit
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is unsustainably fast and the hold-up horses get too far behind
scenarios.body: Ramo and Guernesey will be perfectly positioned just behind the leaders to pick up the pieces when the front three stop. Their prominent running style allows them to stay in touch without getting embroiled in the early pace battle.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Completely
scenarios.trigger: If all three front-runners go too fast too early and tie each other up completely
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint from the final fence with any horse in contention having a chance. This scenario creates chaos where any runner with a turn of foot can capitalise, regardless of their usual running style.

watchPoints.text: Kyntara and Rocheval setting unsustainably fast fractions early as both are confirmed front-runners who may not settle behind
Jupiter Des Mottes getting too far back in the early stages given the strong pace will create significant gaps
Ballin Bay's ability to dominate the lead if the other two pace-setters clash and take each other on
First-time headgear changes on Adveram (cheekpieces) and Maura Jeanne (visor) potentially improving their focus
Sean Bowen's booking for Dr Seb suggesting Olly Murphy fancies his chances in this grade

races.paceDynamic: Rock N Roll Champ will set the pace from flag to finish, with Gonnino, Blended Stealth and Takeyoutotheisland tracking him in the early stages. The lone leader has been given a soft ride recently and can sustain a solid gallop without pressure, creating a genuine tempo that will string the field out over this staying trip on testing ground. The majority of the field are hold-up horses who will need the pace to collapse, but Rock N Roll Champ's uncontested lead makes this unlikely. This setup strongly favours prominent racers and the pace-setter — the tempo will be honest but not destructive, and those tracking the leader will have first run on the closers.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Leader Wins
scenarios.trigger: If Rock N Roll Champ gets an easy lead and dictates throughout
scenarios.body: The 8-year-old can bowl along at his own rhythm with Edward Austin's 5lb claim negating the headgear penalty, while the hold-up brigade face an impossible task from too far back. His recent form shows consistent placing when getting a soft lead.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Gonnino or Takeyoutotheisland track the leader and pounce late
scenarios.body: The prominent racers can sit in Rock N Roll Champ's slipstream before striking in the final furlong when the leader's stamina wanes. Their tactical positioning gives them first run on the hold-up horses.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Surge
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses or Rock N Roll Champ stops suddenly
scenarios.body: Sattam or Kicksaftersix could produce their trademark late flourish if the gallop becomes tactical or the leader hits the wall. Their class ratings suggest they have the ability if getting the right race shape.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Scramble
scenarios.trigger: If Rock N Roll Champ goes too slow and creates a sprint finish
scenarios.body: A bunched field turning for home would favour the handiest horses with tactical speed rather than pure stamina. This seems unlikely given the leader's natural galloping style.

watchPoints.text: Rock N Roll Champ could get such an easy lead that he's impossible to peg back, especially with the 5lb weight allowance
Sattam has the highest RPR of 103 and Ryan Mania's booking suggests stable confidence despite the tactical disadvantage
Sean Bowen riding Belvedere Bhoy stands out as the best jockey in the field, suggesting this hold-up horse has a live chance
First-time headgear on Rock N Roll Champ and King Kodiak indicates both stables are trying to find improvement
The going has been consistent Good to Soft all day at Carlisle, negating any significant track bias concerns

races.paceDynamic: Lord De Vinci and Blazing Court will likely dispute the early lead with both rated as prominent runners, but with only these two keen for the pace this won't create a punishing gallop. The majority of this field are hold-up horses who will be content to settle in behind, meaning the leaders can dictate terms without pressure. Different Drum, Au Plaisir, and Out On Her Own represent the strongest of the hold-up contingent who will need the pace to be solid enough to close into. This setup moderately favours hold-up horses as the pace should be honest but not overly strong, allowing closers to pick up the pieces if the leaders weaken.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-up horses dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Lord De Vinci and Blazing Court set steady fractions without killing themselves
scenarios.body: The pace becomes too moderate for the leaders to sustain their kick, allowing the stronger stayers from behind to sweep past. Different Drum and Au Plaisir benefit most from this patient tactical scenario.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front-runners stay strong
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is genuinely testing and the prominent pair get into a rhythm
scenarios.body: Lord De Vinci and Blazing Court avoid the typical fate of front-runners by maintaining their positions when the field closes. Their early positioning proves decisive when the hold-up horses can't quite get there.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Midrace shuffle changes everything
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes stop-start with the leaders going too slowly early
scenarios.body: The lack of early tempo means the race becomes a sprint from halfway, suiting horses with tactical speed over pure stamina. This scenario brings unexposed improvers and those with turn of foot into play.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Outsider emerges from chaos
scenarios.trigger: If the favorites get caught up in traffic or tactical problems
scenarios.body: A pace collapse or interference allows a bigger-priced runner to steal through and capitalize on others' misfortune. Hobnail's tendency to fade late makes this less likely but stranger things have happened at Carlisle.

watchPoints.text: Lord De Vinci's jumping under pressure - if asked to go a strong pace early his technique could deteriorate quickly
Blazing Court's fitness after 109 days off - amateur jockey may not get the best out of him if he needs the run
Hobnail's tendency to fade badly - if traveling well turning in, expect the effort to flatten out markedly in the final furlong
Au Plaisir's response to first-time tongue-tie - Rebecca Menzies applying new headgear suggests they expect improvement
Different Drum's jumping rhythm - has been consistent recently but needs to maintain fluency to capitalize on his strong RPR

races.paceDynamic: Voleur De Terres is the only confirmed front-runner and will dictate proceedings from the flag, likely going clear early with Steal The Moves and Tory Hill for company in the early stages. The lack of genuine pace pressure means Voleur De Terres can control the tempo and kick for home when ready, potentially stringing out the seven hold-up horses behind. With most of the field needing to come from off the pace, they'll be reliant on the leaders folding late. This setup strongly favours prominent runners and the pace-setter — genuine hold-up horses face a tactical disadvantage with limited early pace to aim at.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Voleur De Terres gets an uncontested lead and maintains stamina
scenarios.body: The pace-setter controls the race from pillar to post with the hold-up brigade unable to close the gap in time. Claire Dyson's runner has been running well in defeat and gets the perfect tactical scenario here.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Late Surge
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace becomes genuinely testing and the leaders tire
scenarios.body: The prominent runners go too fast early allowing the class horses from the back to unleash late runs. Super Citizen and Jamesieconn have the highest ratings and will benefit from a strong gallop.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Wins
scenarios.trigger: If a prominent runner sits just behind the leader and outfinishes
scenarios.body: One of the horses tracking the pace-setter times their run perfectly to collar Voleur De Terres in the final furlong. The tactical position proves crucial in a slowly-run race.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Surprise Outsider Victory
scenarios.trigger: If the favourites fail to handle the conditions or make jumping errors
scenarios.body: An unfancied runner sneaks through as the market leaders disappoint, taking advantage of a messy pace scenario. The handicapper's lenient mark proves crucial.

watchPoints.text: Voleur De Terres gets an uncontested lead and dictates terms throughout
Super Citizen and Jamesieconn struggle to get competitive from hold-up positions in slowly-run race
Baptism Of Fire shows any signs of the old spark after string of disappointing efforts
Early pace becomes genuinely testing which would favour the hold-up brigade
Steal The Moves tracks the leader closely and times run to perfection

races.paceDynamic: Ryebridge is the sole confirmed front-runner and will set a sustainable pace from the start without early pressure. Micks Jet, Moyganny Phil and Matching Energy are the prominent racers who will track just behind, but none are confirmed pace-pressers. The majority of the field including Two Brothers, Las Canals, Wind Your Neck In, Heritier and Chumlee are hold-up horses who will be held up in the rear divisions. This setup strongly favours hold-up horses — with only one leader setting his own fractions, the pace will be controlled and the field will finish in a bunch sprint where stamina and a strong finish matter most.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Ryebridge sets uncontested fractions and the pace stays modest through the middle stages
scenarios.body: The field will arrive in a bunch at the final flight with plenty left to give, perfectly suiting the patient tactics of the hold-up brigade. Two Brothers, Las Canals and Wind Your Neck In all have the class and finishing kick to capitalize.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Micks Jet or Moyganny Phil sit perfectly positioned tracking Ryebridge and kick clear before the hold-up horses can respond
scenarios.body: The prominent racers will have first run on the field and can steal crucial lengths turning in. Micks Jet's higher OR of 107 and solid recent form makes him the most likely to execute this.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Ryebridge Wire-to-Wire
scenarios.trigger: If the pace is genuinely strong early and Ryebridge's stamina reserves prove superior to the field
scenarios.body: His recent win at Sedgefield shows he can handle this trip on soft ground, and if the hold-up horses leave their runs too late he can hold on. Danny McMenamin knows him well and will judge the fractions perfectly.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Chaos and Long Shot
scenarios.trigger: If there are fallers, interference or the pace completely collapses into a crawl
scenarios.body: A muddling pace or incident-packed race can throw form out the window and favour an outsider getting a dream run. Heritier or Chumlee could benefit from race-shape chaos despite their modest ratings.

watchPoints.text: Watch Ryebridge early - if he goes off too fast trying to build an unassailable lead, he'll set up the race for the hold-up horses perfectly
Monitor Two Brothers' jumping rhythm - his hold-up style depends on clean leaping to maintain position and deliver his finishing kick
Keep an eye on Micks Jet's fitness - returning after 349 days off, any signs of rustiness early will end his chances
Watch for Heritier's response to first-time cheekpieces - the headgear change suggests connections are trying something new
Observe how Matching Energy settles early given his prominent style and relatively inexperienced trainer Bourke's handling

runners_data.name: Tarbuck

races.paceDynamic: Tarbuck is the only confirmed front runner in this field and should get an uncontested lead at a sustainable gallop. With most runners preferring to be held up, there's minimal early pace pressure which creates a sit-and-sprint finish rather than a true staying test. The lack of pace pressure means the field will bunch up turning for home, creating a cavalry charge finish where positioning and a strong finishing kick become crucial. This setup strongly favours hold-up horses with tactical speed — the lack of early pace means they can get closer than usual and unleash late runs.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is modest as expected with Tarbuck uncontested.
scenarios.body: The field stays bunched and it becomes a sprint finish where horses with proven finishing kicks can capitalise on good positioning. Late runners with class like Red Cadillac and Devon Skies can time their challenges perfectly.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Runners Strike
scenarios.trigger: If Yapper Hill or another runner decides to track Tarbuck more aggressively than expected.
scenarios.body: This creates slightly more pace that stretches the field marginally, allowing horses racing handy to steal a march on the hold-up brigade. Tarbuck benefits from company and Yapper Hill gets first run.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Suits Class
scenarios.trigger: If Tarbuck goes too slow and the race becomes a complete crawl.
scenarios.body: The superior class horses can overcome poor positioning as stamina becomes less important in a sprint finish. Higher-rated performers like Kado Sacree and Rauzan can use their quality despite being held up.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Outsider Benefits From Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If the pace is so steady that it becomes a complete lottery with traffic problems.
scenarios.body: Positioning luck becomes crucial and a horse like Half Track or Disco Annie can benefit from a clean passage when others are stuck behind fallers or struggling horses. Experience counts in messy finishes.

watchPoints.text: Tarbuck's fitness after 70 days off - if he weakens turning for home the pace could completely collapse into chaos
Red Cadillac's ability to get a clear run from the back given his hold-up style in a bunched finish scenario
Devon Skies maintaining his hat-trick form under pressure when the pace quickens after what could be a slow early gallop
Yapper Hill's positioning early - if he tracks Tarbuck closely it creates the main alternative pace scenario
Half Track getting the benefit of the 7lb apprentice claim in what could be a tight finish between hold-up horses
